description: C2: the Broken Warden's walls cut down to a giant's harness by the masons of the old toll-keep once he has fallen - dressed gate-stone in courses, merlons on the shoulders and the helm, the gate's iron and chain, his keystone. The heaviest harness a forge makes: it takes a blow as his wall did, it holds a giant's footing, and it slows the breath.

bonuses.name: Shield-wall
bonuses.text: Blocking costs 40% less stamina, and armour +4: a blow on your guard is a blow on a wall

bonuses.name: The Warden's Stand
bonuses.text: Poise damage taken -25%: you hold your ground as he held his gate
